text:
alex.chen: Heads-up: from postmortem, we need to track the residency leak recap + action owner timeline. Kicking off a smokehouse play to reduce KV OOM recurrence. Owners below.
maria.patel: Thanks. Can we include the recent heap profile? It shows hot shard growth after ~6h.
ben.ortiz: Uploaded flamegraphs to s3: s3://redwood-ci/profiles/3915-kv-leak-flames.svg. Will run `heap-scan --shard=all --snap=latest` today.
sam.gupta: Plan: 1) heap profiles + stack traces; 2) enable soft-limit enforcement on canary; 3) GC tuning (freq + compaction); 4) eviction policy tweak (age-based).
infra-bot: deploy: canary pool update started for `kv-service` (tag: patch/residency-guard).
alex.chen: Owners: profiling = @ben.ortiz, canary + limits = @maria.patel, GC tune = @sam.gupta, dashboards/alerts = @alex.chen. Timeline: profiling by Tue EOD, canary Wed 10:00 UTC, full rollout Fri.
maria.patel: For soft-limit, I'm setting `--kv-soft-limit=0.75` and `--eviction-window=30s`. Will push config PR and add rollback job.
ben.ortiz: Started heap-scan now. hitting some noisy allocs from shard-merger. snippet of logs:
```
2026-03-22T09:12:34Z shard=42 alloc=1.2GB tmp_buffer
2026-03-22T09:12:39Z shard=42 grow=+120MB KV-reserve
```
I'll annotate in PR.
sam.gupta: GC plan: bump `minor_gc_interval` from 300s -> 120s on canary; run fragment compaction every 2 hours. Also testing `jemalloc` opt flags.
maria.patel: Canary config PR: https://git.redwood/s/maria/kv-softlimit-pr. Adding a canary gate: `metric(kv_residency)>70% for 5m` will pause rollout.
alex.chen: Please add an alert to Paging: `kv_residency_spike` with runbook link. Make sure slack notify channel #eng-runtime and include `oncall-june`.
oncall-june: Acknowledged. I'll temp mute noisy test alerts and watch the canary from 10:00-13:00 UTC Wed.
ben.ortiz: Prelim profiling shows fragmentation ratio ~0.28 on affected shards. Hypothesis: reserve allocations + tiny slab churn. I'll try slab-size bump + fragmentation GC.
sam.gupta: Action items checklist:
- ben: full heap-scan + slab sizing proposal (due Tue)
- maria: PR + canary rollout + rollback job (due Wed)
- sam: GC tuning and jemalloc opt test (due Thu)
- alex: dashboard + alert + runbook (due Wed)
- oncall: temp watch (Wed 10-13)
I'll update the postmortem with the checklist.
maria.patel: :thumbsup: adding owners to the PR. Also enabling metric export `kv_fragmentation` at 1m resolution.
ben.ortiz: If canary looks good, propose soft limit sticky at 0.8 for Prod; will prepare change request for Dedicated clusters.
alex.chen: We should also schedule a 30min follow-up retro next week to verify recurrence rate drop. Propose Tue 14:00 UTC.
oncall-june: Booked: Tue 14:00 UTC. I'll pull incident logs for the 90-day window.
infra-bot: deploy: canary pool update complete on 3/23 10:05 UTC. Monitoring: baseline metrics posted.
maria.patel: Initial canary: +0.6% latency, -14% peak memory on canary shards. No alerts. Rolling to 25%.
sam.gupta: Reminder: add `eviction_burst_limit` to config so we don't thrash eviction during startup.
ben.ortiz: Running slab resize experiment now. Results ETA 24h.
alex.chen: Great. I'll keep the thread only for action updates. If new signals appear open a new incident channel. Thanks team.
